2609.01591.title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
2609.01591.paper_summary: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. Across all three domains, StudentSim outperforms GPT-5.4 on both metrics. In chess, StudentSim reaches F=0.51 and R=0.91, compared with 0.23 and 0.72 for GPT-5.4 and 0.45 and 0.27 for Maia2. As a proof of concept, using StudentSim as a reward model for tutor reinforcement learning produces a chess tutor that expert humans rate as more accurate, better-guided, and more personalized than a no-RL baseline and a tutor trained against a GPT-5.4 simulator reward. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim.
2609.01591.paper_summary_zh: AI 輔導員在適應每位學生的優勢、弱點和偏好指導時最為有用，但有關哪種指導適合哪位學生的證據稀少、收集緩慢且成本高昂。學生模擬器可以作為代理提供這種信號，但現有的方法有限：狀態追蹤模型能夠適應學生行為，但在處理解釋或修正方面存在困難，而大型語言模型角色扮演流暢地遵循指導，但無法可靠地匹配被模仿學生的能力。我們提出了 StudentSim，一個訓練框架，通過集中訓練將稀疏的每位學生數據轉化為個性化模擬器，隨後進行每位學生的專門化。所產生的模擬器不僅反映學生自己的反應，還在輔導員的指導下進行更新。我們還介紹了 StudentSimEval，一個標準化協議，涵蓋了 60 名學生，涉及國際象棋、第二語言英語寫作和數學，使用共享的公共學習者數據集，並提供去識別化的記錄以供研究。StudentSimEval 測量行為忠實度 (F)，即模擬器與學生反應的匹配程度，以及指導響應性 (R)，即在輔導員指導下的更新速度，所有方法均在相同記錄上進行擬合和評估。在所有三個領域中，StudentSim 在這兩個指標上均優於 GPT-5.4。在國際象棋方面，StudentSim 達到 F=0.51 和 R=0.91，而 GPT-5.4 分別為 0.23 和 0.72，Maia2 則為 0.45 和 0.27。作為概念驗證，將 StudentSim 作為輔導員強化學習的獎勵模型，產生的國際象棋輔導員被專家人類評價為比無強化學習基準和對抗 GPT-5.4 模擬器獎勵訓練的輔導員更準確、更具指導性和更具個性化。代碼可在 https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim 獲得。
